verdict.rationale: Oyster documents both sides of the story on one platform. It offers EOR employment with multi-country payroll in 120+ currencies, and it lets you generate contracts and send payments to freelance and short-term contractors. However, the evidence frames this as global EOR and contractor management. Nothing addresses US W-2 employees or 1099 contractor tax handling specifically. Missing for 10: explicit US W-2 payroll support, 1099 contractor payment and tax-form handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of paying both worker types side by side.
